$Comment: How boosts add up on this server. Cap is the most every boost on one track adds up to, as a percent (200 is three times a gain); HighestOnly counts only the strongest server boost and the strongest personal one; Limits are how many may run at once. OnStart runs a server command as the console whenever a boost starts, any mod's: set Enabled true to use it, Personal and Server say which starts run it, and ReplacesAnnouncement keeps the library's own line to everyone off for a server boost whose command announces it. The command's placeholders are {player}, {multiplier}, {target}, {duration}, {scope} and {boost}. Change any of them in mods/ziggfreedcommon/boost-settings.json, under the id Default.
